name: mochi-chatgpt
description: Send ChatGPT replies to the local Mochi desktop character without another model call.

interface.shortDescription: Let Mochi display your ChatGPT replies.
interface.longDescription: Connect an existing ChatGPT conversation to the local Mochi character over MCP. ChatGPT supplies the text; Mochi presents it in the selected bubble material.
interface.defaultPrompt: 把这次回复交给 Mochi 桌宠显示。
